name: dentist-crm
description: Premium practice management CRM for dental clinics (MERN)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
